name: Akabanebashi
tagline: Roppongi in 4 minutes and Shinjuku in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 24 minutes to Otemachi, 14 minutes to Shinjuku, 18 minutes to Shibuya and 20 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. The station stands 4.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 4.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.2 m to 21.6 m, a difference of 17.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 2 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 15 clinics and 11 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 国際医療福祉大学三田病院, about 1 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京都済生会中央病院, about 2 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥290,000 to ¥300,000 and 2LDK ¥620,000 to ¥630,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. For One room, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shibakoen, but Akabanebashi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 15 minutes sooner than Akabanebashi. One-room rents run about ¥28,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: Azabu-Juban is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is, but Akabanebashi is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Akabanebashi. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 lower.

noiseSources: The 首都高速都心環状線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
環状三号線 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
